questions.q: What is the capital of Guatemala?
questions.why: It is the largest city in Central America.

questions.q: Which ancient civilisation built Tikal?
questions.why: Its pyramids rise above the jungle.

questions.q: From which country did Guatemala gain independence in 1821?
questions.why: It was briefly part of Mexico.

questions.q: Which K'iche' Maya activist won the 1992 Nobel Peace Prize?
questions.why: She campaigned for Indigenous rights.

questions.q: What is Guatemala's currency?
questions.why: It is named after a bird.

questions.q: Which civil war lasted from 1960 to 1996?
questions.why: Peace accords ended it in 1996.

questions.q: Which colonial city was the old capital until an earthquake in 1773?
questions.why: It is a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which President was overthrown in a CIA-backed coup in 1954?
questions.why: His land reform angered the United Fruit Company.

questions.q: Which Guatemalan novelist won the 1967 Nobel Prize in Literature?
questions.why: He wrote 'El Señor Presidente'.

questions.q: Which K'iche' Maya book tells the creation story?
questions.why: It was written down in the 1500s.

questions.q: Which Spanish conquistador conquered Guatemala in 1524?
questions.why: He was one of Cortés's captains.

questions.q: Who became President of Guatemala in 2024?
questions.why: He is the son of a former President.

questions.q: Which K'iche' hero fought Alvarado in 1524?
questions.why: He is a national hero.

questions.q: Which Maya site is linked to the 'Star Wars' rebel base?
questions.why: It was filmed for the 1977 film.

questions.q: Which general ruled during the worst massacres of 1982–83?
questions.why: He was convicted of genocide in 2013.

questions.q: Which deep lake is surrounded by three volcanoes?
questions.why: Aldous Huxley called it the world's most beautiful lake.

questions.q: Which colourful bird is Guatemala's national symbol?
questions.why: It is on the flag.

questions.q: Which market town is famous for its huge Maya market?
questions.why: It is held on Thursdays and Sundays.

questions.q: Which crop is Guatemala famous for exporting?
questions.why: Antigua coffee is well known.

questions.q: Which colourful embroidered blouse do Maya women wear?
questions.why: Each village has its own patterns.

questions.q: Which old US school buses are painted bright colours in Guatemala?
questions.why: They run between towns.

questions.q: Which language family do many Guatemalans speak besides Spanish?
questions.why: There are over 20 of them.

questions.q: Which Semana Santa tradition fills Antigua's streets?
questions.why: Processions walk over them.

questions.q: Which active volcano near Antigua often erupts?
questions.why: It erupted deadly in 2018.

questions.q: What is Guatemala's highest mountain?
questions.why: It is the highest point in Central America.

questions.q: Which turquoise pools sit over a natural limestone bridge?
questions.why: They are in Alta Verapaz.

questions.q: Which spicy meat stew is Guatemala's national dish?
questions.why: It mixes Maya and Spanish styles.

questions.q: Which giant kites are flown on All Saints' Day?
questions.why: Sumpango holds a famous festival.

questions.q: Which island town sits on Lake Petén Itzá?
questions.why: It is the gateway to Tikal.

questions.q: Which Garífuna town on the Caribbean is reached only by boat?
questions.why: Garífuna culture is on UNESCO's list.
